svg.title: MOD-17473 — AWS full-output performance
svg.desc: Equal-work performance comparison of baseline and array-backed replies. Every row shows ten paired candidate-versus-baseline effects, five AB and five BA, plus a paired-bootstrap confidence interval.
svg.text: Equal complete replies · baseline 20ba4ed7c2 → candidate 3ff80fa72 · AWS Ubuntu / AMD EPYC 7R32
Every case: 10 paired runs = 10 baseline + 10 candidate measurements (20 fresh Redis processes); balanced 5 AB / 5 BA
Dots/squares are the 10 actual paired effects in every row. Blue band = ±3% equivalence. CI = 10,000 whole-pair resamples (seed 17473), not benchmark runs.
Plotted equal-work subset: 12 cases × 10 pairs = 120 pairs / 240 observations. Whole campaign: 18 cases × 10 = 180 pairs / 360 observations (90 AB, 90 BA).
Timeout cases are omitted because baseline and candidate returned different row distributions and therefore did unequal work.
